summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Sureste (ASUR), a Mexican airport group reporting on Form 6-K, proposes internalizing technical assistance services via a merger, paying two extraordinary cash dividends of Ps.10.00 each in November and December 2026, and amending bylaws. The internalization would issue ~7.251M new shares and was overseen by its Audit Committee with J.P. Morgan as advisor. This is equivalent to a US special dividend and internal reorganization proposal. Watch shareholder vote on the internalization and dividend approval; no risk-arb as this is not a take-private.
